name: Highwater Camp River Access
facilities: Private campground on a gravel bar. River Access Pass holders may drive onto the gravel bar to drop off or pick up people, gear and boats, and leave one vehicle in the parking area. No boat rentals or shuttles.
description: Private gravel-bar launch at Highwater Camp, sold to non-campers through the camp's River Access Pass (reservation only); campers launch free. The owner supplied this pin on 2026-11-09 (plus code 5838+4J Watts = 8687 5838+4J); it is 39 m from the river line at Eddy mile 59.08, about 200 m from the operator's business pin, consistent with GRDA mile 11.8. Every private boat still needs a GRDA float permit; no rentals or shuttles.
confidence: medium (operator River Access Pass terms; owner-supplied pin 2026-11-09, plus code 5838+4J Watts)
fee_notes: Non-campers need a River Access Pass (RAP), reserved in advance: $10 per vehicle per day, up to 8 people, limited to 5 passes a day, valid 7 a.m.-8:30 p.m., May 1-Nov 15. It covers launch, takeout and one parked vehicle; not for commercial use. Overnight parking for multi-day trips is $5/night (max 3 nights) with an emailed itinerary. Campers do not need a RAP. Every private watercraft also needs a GRDA day or annual float permit; HWC does not sell them.
road_access: 468501 E. 599th Road, Watts, OK 74964. Approach from the north side of the river via the 4700 road, then 599th Road. The operator warns against routes using the 4693, 4685 or 0592 roads, and the Carnes Ford low-water crossing is washed out.
parking_info: One vehicle per River Access Pass in the HWC parking area. Do not walk or drive through camping areas.
